scenes.role: establish the friends’ different wishes and the pool’s quiet-hour limit
scenes.prerequisites: The friends arrive before the main gate closes.
scenes.actions: Nia brings a blank nature card; Rowan describes the frogs he hopes to hear.
scenes.consequences: The pool visit has a time pressure, while both friends have a reason to explore.
scenes.prose_obligations: Give each friend an ordinary want; do not cast Rowan as a problem to discard.

scenes.role: introduce the borrowed object and its return obligation
scenes.prerequisites: Ranger Inez is at the trailhead.
scenes.actions: Nia borrows Inez’s brass compass; Inez asks for it back that evening.
scenes.consequences: Compass holder changes to Nia; the owner remains Inez; return is required by either ending.
scenes.prose_obligations: Show both why the compass matters and that it must be returned.

scenes.role: test the compass rather than assuming it is reliable
scenes.prerequisites: The compass has been borrowed.
scenes.actions: Compare its needle with the board’s north arrow.
scenes.consequences: Record a calibrated or wandering reading; the result affects shortcut eligibility and later prose.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not claim an uncertain instrument gave a certain bearing.

scenes.role: introduce the marked ridge and tempting shortcut
scenes.prerequisites: The trail card is available.
scenes.actions: The friends inspect the white-blazed ridge and the stone-step shortcut.
scenes.consequences: Establish why a route choice will matter.
scenes.prose_obligations: Keep route descriptions physically understandable.

scenes.role: optional landmark vignette
scenes.prerequisites: Compass borrowed; route not yet chosen; fern not already observed.
scenes.actions: Rowan notices the brook bend beside a fern and remembers its direction.
scenes.consequences: Adds four minutes and persistent stream knowledge; if needed, that landmark calibrates the drifting compass.
scenes.prose_obligations: This scene may be omitted; no fern knowledge or calibration occurs offstage.

scenes.role: consolidated optional navigation beat
scenes.prerequisites: The fern vignette is enacted and the compass still drifts.
scenes.actions: Compare the brook bend with the needle.
scenes.consequences: Calibrates the compass from an observed landmark.
scenes.prose_obligations: Mention calibration only when the local action records it.

scenes.role: introduce Rowan’s slower pace as a concrete physical constraint
scenes.prerequisites: Rowan is walking in new boots.
scenes.actions: Rowan admits the seam is rubbing his heel.
scenes.consequences: Makes the steep shortcut an unsuitable choice until the heel is supported.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not frame a manageable sore heel as incapacity or blame.

scenes.role: optional care vignette
scenes.prerequisites: The heel is sore and the route is unchosen.
scenes.actions: Nia uses first-aid tape from the trail pouch.
scenes.consequences: Heel support persists and reduces the later pace cost; the scene adds two minutes.
scenes.prose_obligations: If omitted, Rowan’s heel remains sore and no shortcut eligibility is invented.

scenes.role: present a consequential route option
scenes.prerequisites: Compass borrowed and checked.
scenes.actions: Inspect whether the shortcut is open and whether its steps suit Rowan.
scenes.consequences: Shortcut is executable only when open, the heel is supported, and the compass is calibrated.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not equate the fastest route with the only worthwhile route.

scenes.role: make the temptation to leave the slower friend legible
scenes.prerequisites: Nia wants to reach the pool before its quiet-hour limit.
scenes.actions: Nia briefly considers going ahead, then chooses a route with Rowan.
scenes.consequences: The enacted route always sets friend.included; trust rises through the choice.
scenes.prose_obligations: The generated story must show inclusion as a decision, not a hidden constant.

scenes.role: conditional shorter route
scenes.prerequisites: Shortcut open; heel supported; compass calibrated.
scenes.actions: Choose the shortcut together and record one compass bearing.
scenes.consequences: Shorter travel time, with both friends at the fork.
scenes.prose_obligations: Never send Rowan alone or narrate a crossing he did not make.

scenes.role: inclusive default route
scenes.prerequisites: Compass borrowed and checked; shortcut conditions need not be met.
scenes.actions: Choose the marked ridge together and record the compass bearing.
scenes.consequences: Longer route, both friends remain together, and the route decision persists.
scenes.prose_obligations: Give the ridge choice a reason grounded in openness, footing, or bearing.

scenes.role: make the seed-word puddle a small physical complication
scenes.prerequisites: A route has been chosen.
scenes.actions: Assess the puddle and its stepping stones.
scenes.consequences: Depth and rain choose the enacted crossing or marked edge; time and muddy boots persist.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not teleport across the obstacle or give the friends incompatible locations.

scenes.role: resolve the puddle with an accessible action
scenes.prerequisites: Both friends reach the puddle together.
scenes.actions: Cross shallow stones together or take the marked bank around deep or rain-swollen water.
scenes.consequences: Both arrive at the far bank; the detour costs more time and may muddy boots.
scenes.prose_obligations: Keep the slower friend’s pace in the action and the prose.

scenes.role: carry route and pace effects forward
scenes.prerequisites: Puddle resolved; both friends remain together.
scenes.actions: Walk the ridge or shortcut at Rowan’s actual pace, checking blazes and bearing.
scenes.consequences: Adds route-, pace-, support-, and weather-dependent time.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not narrate the compass as calibrated when it is not.

scenes.role: show reciprocal attention during travel
scenes.prerequisites: The friends are on their chosen route.
scenes.actions: Rowan notices fresh chips and Nia stops to look.
scenes.consequences: Consolidated into the route-walk encounter; no separate hidden time or state change.
scenes.prose_obligations: Let Nia’s attention change rather than treating Rowan only as a delay.

scenes.role: resolve whether the desired pool remains safe and accessible
scenes.prerequisites: Puddle and route walk are enacted.
scenes.actions: Check rain and elapsed minutes against the pool window.
scenes.consequences: Clear and timely arrival permits the pool; rain or a missed window leads to shelter.
scenes.prose_obligations: Do not narrate a pool visit on the shelter branch.

scenes.role: successful discovery
scenes.prerequisites: No rain and elapsed minutes within the pool window.
scenes.actions: Nia and Rowan observe and sketch the glasswing butterfly together.
scenes.consequences: Sets the pool discovery and permits the pool ending.
scenes.prose_obligations: Make the success shared, not a reward for outpacing Rowan.

scenes.role: complete, emotionally earned setback
scenes.prerequisites: Rain or elapsed minutes beyond the pool window.
scenes.actions: Turn to the safe shelter and listen to frogs in the wet grass.
scenes.consequences: Sets a different discovery and permits the shelter ending; the pool is not claimed.
scenes.prose_obligations: Give the missed goal a real consequence and the alternative discovery its own value.

scenes.role: bring the friends home and return the useful borrowed object
scenes.prerequisites: A pool or shelter discovery is recorded.
scenes.actions: Follow marked trail home; return Inez’s compass and report whether it wandered or was corrected.
scenes.consequences: Returns the compass to its owner, records its usefulness, and closes with one of two outcomes.
scenes.prose_obligations: Complete the return and give both endings emotional closure.
